en_lines: Melancholy fills my breast, and he wander through the quiet scene.
The river flows onward, and the traveler drift along the quiet scene.
The crescent moon, and the traveler linger by the quiet scene.
One stand still, watching as distant peaks stand tall.
It is the time when winter snow falls, and you ponder on in quiet thought.
It is the time when grief weighs upon my soul, and he rest beside in quiet thought.
It is the time when sad thoughts arise unbidden, and the traveler approach in quiet thought.
It is the time when children play by the village gate, and the poet behold in quiet thought.
I stand before the azure vault.
